title: Easy to handle
text: Easy to handle. I like this pitcher because It is easy to handle, comfortable in my hand and not heavy when its full. I was using a larger pitcher Made out of thin plastic that The handle became kind of wobbly when it was full. I love the acrylic because it looks like glass But it doesn't break easy. This 1 has a nice dark blue pattern on it.
